naslov: Whoever Guarantees Me Two Things, I Guarantee Him Jannah

segmenti.tekst: إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ
segmenti.prevod: Indeed, all praise belongs to Allah; we praise Him, seek His help and ask His forgiveness.

segmenti.tekst: وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا وَمِنْ سَيِّئَاتِ أَعْمَالِنَا مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ
segmenti.prevod: We seek refuge in Allah from the evils of our souls and from our bad deeds. Whomever Allah guides, none can lead astray, and whomever He leaves astray, none can guide.

segmenti.tekst: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
segmenti.prevod: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, Who has no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

segmenti.tekst: أَرْسَلَهُ اللَّهُ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا لِيُنْذِرَ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الْكِرَامِ الْهُدَاةِ الْمُهْتَدِينَ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيرًا إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
segmenti.prevod: Allah sent him with the truth as a bearer of glad tidings, a warner and a light-giving lamp, to warn whoever is alive (of heart) and so that the Word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers (Ya-Sin 36:70). May Allah the Exalted bless him and his good and pure family and his noble companions, the rightly guided who guided others, and grant him abundant peace until the Day of Judgement.

segmenti.tekst: قَالَ اللَّهُ فِي كِتَابِهِ الْكَرِيمِ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ أَمَّا بَعْدُ
segmenti.prevod: Allah says in His noble Book: “O you who believe, fear Allah as He deserves to be feared, and do not die except as Muslims.” (Al Imran 3:102). To proceed:

segmenti.tekst: Praise belongs to the One, Exalted Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala (glorified and exalted is He), Lord of all the worlds, Lord of the Day of Judgment, Lord of jinn and mankind, and blessings and peace be upon His Messenger, the beloved Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam (peace be upon him), upon his family, upon his companions, and upon all those who follow the path, the path of the Qur'an, the path of the Sunnah of Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam. Dear brothers, respected congregation, our Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, was the most eloquent of men.

He was the most eloquent of men, and his words carry special weight. Besides that, revelation came to him from Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala. Our Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, warned us about certain things that a person should avoid and guard himself against.
This is especially pronounced today, in these times, for the believer, for a mu'min, in times that are very hard, that are very hard and bring many challenges.

Let us just listen to the words of the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, or the hadith narrated by Sahl and recorded by Bukhari, that the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, says… He says: “Whoever guarantees me what is between his jaws and what is between his legs,” he says, “I guarantee him” – what?

Jannah (Paradise). “I guarantee him Jannah.” Why, dear brothers, does the Prophet mention precisely the tongue and the private parts? Why? Because a person is tested the most precisely through these two organs.

We have the tongue, with which a person can do a lot of khayr (good), he can do a great deal of good: call people to good, to the worship of Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala – that is a great blessing – reconcile two of his Muslim brothers. But it can also do a lot of evil, especially in today's times, when with a single call a person can do evil to a third person somewhere on the other side of the world.

That is how pronounced it is today. That is how dangerous the tongue is, if a person uses it for what is evil, for what is wrong. That is why a person should be careful about what he talks about, what he says, and of course this should also be a motivation for him.

Let this hadith of the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, be, be a motivation for him, and let him also know that beside him there is always someone who records what he says. Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, says: “Ma yalfizu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqibun 'atid.” And He says: a person does not utter a single word without there being beside him one who, who records – that is an angel.

The angel records everything a person utters. The second thing that the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, mentions is the private parts. Today, dear brothers, this is so pronounced, and it is so hard to preserve chastity when we see how much indecency there is on the streets.

In the past this did not exist, even in non-believing countries. In the past there was not… Abu Jahl's wife dressed better than our wives, our daughters do today, unfortunately. That is our condition, so a person – it is hard for him to guard, to guard his private parts.

And that is precisely why the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, mentions precisely the private parts. When a person can satisfy himself, and in his own room he can see what our forefathers could not even imagine.
But in order for a person to guard his private parts, he must first guard what, dear brothers? He must guard his gaze.
And the proof of this for us is a verse of the Qur'an. What does Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, say: “And tell the believing men to lower their gaze
and to guard their private parts.” A person cannot guard his private parts without lowering his gaze. Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala, also says:
وَقُلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ
segmenti.prevod: “And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and guard their chastity…” (An-Nur 24:31)

segmenti.tekst: “And tell the believing women to lower their gaze,” and when they lower their gaze, they will, of course, also guard their private parts. So it is with a man, and so it is with a woman.

That is why the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, mentions precisely these two organs to us, in order to motivate us to guard them, in order to motivate us toward Jannah. Because, dear brothers, he is not wise who, for a brief enjoyment, this worldly enjoyment, gives up the enjoyment of the Hereafter, the enjoyment of Jannah, eternal, eternal enjoyment.

That is why, dear brothers, let us guard our gaze, let us guard our chastity, let us guard our children, let us raise them in the spirit of Islam, in the spirit of these hadiths of the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, especially, as we said, in these times that are truly hard, hard for a, for a believer. I ask Allah, subhanahu wa ta'ala,
to make us among His sincere servants. I ask Him, the Exalted, to forgive us our sins and the sins of our parents. I ask Him, the Exalted, to admit us into Jannah. Amin, ya Rabb al-alamin.

بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لِي وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيمِ وَنَفَعَنِي وَإِيَّاكُمْ بِمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ وَالذِّكْرِ الْحَكِيمِ أَقُولُ قَوْلِي هَٰذَا وَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ لِي وَلَكُمْ فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
segmenti.prevod: May Allah bless me and you through the Mighty Qur’an and benefit me and you with the verses and the wise reminder it contains. I say these words of mine and ask Allah for forgiveness for myself and for you, so ask Him for forgiveness; truly He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

segmenti.tekst: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segmenti.prevod: Allah is the Greatest. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

segmenti.tekst: الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۝ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
segmenti.prevod: The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgement. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help. (Al-Fatihah 1:1–5)

segmenti.tekst: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
segmenti.prevod: “Guide us to the straight path, the path of those You have blessed, not of those who have earned Your anger, nor of those who have gone astray.” (Al-Fatihah 1:6–7)

segmenti.tekst: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَأُولُو الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ ۚ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
segmenti.prevod: “Allah bears witness that there is no god but Him, as do the angels and those of knowledge, maintaining justice. There is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-Wise.” (Al Imran 3:18)
